actorName.title: Actor name
actorName.description: Requested name of the generated Actor (forwarded from the customer Actor).

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: What the generated Actor should do, as written by the customer. For a revision, the change the customer wants.

language.title: Language/runtime
language.description: Preferred implementation language/runtime, e.g. JavaScript, TypeScript, Python.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional additional information from the customer for the generator.

previousZipUrl.title: Previous Actor ZIP URL (revision)
previousZipUrl.description: Set by the customer Actor for a revision: URL of the previous Actor's ZIP, normally a key-value store record in this account that the customer Actor uploaded. It is downloaded, checked and copied into this run as PREVIOUS_ACTOR_ZIP.

previousZipSha256.title: Previous ZIP SHA-256 (revision)
previousZipSha256.description: Set by the customer Actor: SHA-256 of the ZIP at previousZipUrl, used to detect a corrupted transfer.

previousGeneratorRunId.title: Previous generator run (revision)
previousGeneratorRunId.description: Set by the customer Actor for a revision: the run of this Actor that produced the previous Actor. Used to verify the ZIP against the original delivery and as a fallback source when previousZipUrl is absent.

previousCustomerRunId.title: Previous customer run (revision)
previousCustomerRunId.description: Set by the customer Actor for a revision: the customer's earlier run that delivered the previous Actor.

previousActorName.title: Previous Actor name (revision)
previousActorName.description: Set by the customer Actor for a revision: the Actor name used in the previous request.

problemReport.title: Problem report (fix request)
problemReport.description: Set by the customer Actor when the customer reports a failure of an Actor they received: errorLog (tail of the failed run's log), errorLogTruncated, errorLogChars, failedRunInput (input that failed), failedRunId, reportedAt. Stored with the request so the fix can reproduce the failure.

customerContext.title: Customer context
customerContext.description: Metadata added by the customer Actor, such as its run ID, the customer's user ID and submission time.
